exposure: labor induction at 41 + 1 weeks of gestation
expectant management and selective induction at 42 completed weeks
finding: There was no significant difference in perinatal outcomes (cesarean delivery rates, operative vaginal delivery rates) between routine labor induction at 41+1 weeks and expectant management until 42 weeks.
mod_finding: The cesarean delivery rate was 36.5% in the group induced at 41 + 1 weeks and 34.4% in the group with expectant management until 42 weeks.
